basic_details.job_title: IIT(BHU) Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

qualification.education_qualification: M.Tech/M.E./M.S./Master's degree with CGPA/CPI 6.0 and above (10-point scale) or equivalent with GATE/NET-JRF/NET-LS; or M.Tech/M.E./MS with CGPA/CPI more than 7.0 from listed institutions, exempted from GATE/NET.
qualification.details: Qualification: M.Tech/M.E./M.S./Master's degree with CGPA/CPI 6.0 and above (on a 10-point scale) or equivalent from Indian Institutions/Universities with GATE/NET-JRF/NET-LS qualification; OR M.Tech/M.E./MS degree with CGPA/CPI more than 7.0 (or equivalent) from Indian (IITs/NITs/CFTIs/top 100 NIRF State funded) or Foreign (QS Ranking) Institutions/Universities may be exempted from the requirement of GATE/NET-JRF/NET-LS qualification Age limit: Maximum 28 years Age relaxation: SC/ST/Physically Handicapped/Female As per GoI rules | Other conditions: | Desirable: should not have any reservation working at project sites Candidate must confirm willingness to work for the entire sanctioned duration of the project | Desirable: | Proficiency in computer applications/numerical modelling software using PFC/FLAC Previous work experience on rock engineering projects Willing to pursue Ph.D. at IIT(BHU), Varanasi in the domain of the research project

how_to_apply: Fill the application and upload supporting documents using the Google Form link given in the notice, or scan the QR code.
Fill in the application form (format attached) with name, permanent and correspondence address, parents' names, telephone number, e-mail address and educational career from High School or equivalent.

Send a print out of the submitted application form with self-attested supporting documents to Dr. B N V Siva Prasad (Principal Investigator), Department of Mining Engineering, Indian Institute of Technology (BHU), Varanasi – 221005, within 21 days of the advertisement.
important_instructions: All things being equal, SC/ST candidates will be preferred as per GOI rules Self-attested copies of all mark-sheets and certificates are to be sent with the print out

content_sections.text: The official notification gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download IIT(BHU) notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: M.Tech/M.E./M.S./Master's degree with CGPA/CPI 6.0 and above (on a 10-point scale) or equivalent from Indian Institutions/Universities with GATE/NET-JRF/NET-LS qualification; OR M.Tech/M.E./MS degree with CGPA/CPI more than 7.0 (or equivalent) from Indian (IITs/NITs/CFTIs/top 100 NIRF State funded) or Foreign (QS Ranking) Institutions/Universities may be exempted from the requirement of GATE/NET-JRF/NET-LS qualification Age limit: Maximum 28 years Age relaxation: SC/ST/Physically Handicapped/Female As per GoI rules Other conditions: Desirable: should not have any reservation working at project sites Candidate must confirm willingness to work for the entire sanctioned duration of the project Desirable: Proficiency in computer applications/numerical modelling software using PFC/FLAC Previous work experience on rock engineering projects Willing to pursue Ph.D. at IIT(BHU), Varanasi in the domain of the research project

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Post is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project Project sanctioned up to 18 months

rows.event: Last Date (21 days from the advertisement)

content_sections.heading: How Will IIT(BHU) Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Shortlisting of applications Interview of shortlisted candidates (schedule to be intimated to them) Interview schedule will be intimated to the shortlisted candidates No TA/DA will be paid if called for the interview

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Recent passport-size photograph Updated Curriculum Vitae (CV)/Resume Class 10 certificate/mark sheet (proof of date of birth) Degree certificates and mark sheets/transcripts for Diploma, B.Tech./B.E., M.Tech./M.E. and other qualifications, as applicable GATE/NET scorecard (if qualified/claimed) Category certificate (SC/ST/OBC-NCL), if applicable PwBD certificate, if applicable Experience certificates/relieving letters/appointment letters, if applicable

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: All things being equal, SC/ST candidates will be preferred as per GOI rules Self-attested copies of all mark-sheets and certificates are to be sent with the print out

faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 14 December 2026.

faq.answer: Yes. Desirable: should not have any reservation working at project sites. Candidate must confirm willingness to work for the entire sanctioned duration of the project.

faq.answer: Shortlisting of applications. Interview of shortlisted candidates (schedule to be intimated to them). Interview schedule will be intimated to the shortlisted candidates. No TA/DA will be paid if called for the interview.
